result:
Confirmado: cada línea aparece una sola vez en el archivo. La causa aquí no es `jsonParse` (no se usa en este archivo), pero es la misma familia: `context` llega tipado `unknown` desde `PromptCommand['getPromptForCommand']` (`command-runtime/src/types.ts:41`), y se accede sin narrowing. Aplico el mismo principio del `fix_generico` — afirmación de tipo local, acotada al uso real, sin `any`/`as never`/`as unknown as`.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/agent/commands/commit-push-pr.ts", "pattern": "jsonparse-unknown-result-accessed-without-narrowing",
 "edits": [
   {"old": "const command = {\n  type: 'prompt',\n  name: 'commit-push-pr',", "new": "type CommandContextWithAppState = {\n  getAppState: () => {\n    attribution?: unknown\n    toolPermissionContext: { alwaysAllowRules: Record<string, unknown> }\n  }\n}\n\nconst command = {\n  type: 'prompt',\n  name: 'commit-push-pr',"},
   {"old": "      getEnhancedPRAttribution(context.getAppState),", "new": "      getEnhancedPRAttribution((context as CommandContextWithAppState).getAppState),"},
   {"old": "          const appState = context.getAppState()", "new": "          const appState = (context as CommandContextWithAppState).getAppState()"}
 ],
 "fixes": [
   "src/packages/agent/commands/commit-push-pr.ts(124,32): error TS18046: 'context' is of type 'unknown'.",
   "src/packages/agent/commands/commit-push-pr.ts(139,28): error TS18046: 'context' is of type 'unknown'."
 ],
 "skipped": []}
```
